description: `break outer` inside an inner `for` of a value-position arm targets a loop OUTSIDE the arm, so the arm leaves: E-CG-003, not a codegen crash (S462 review N4).
rationale: §19.4.3: a `break` whose target is outside the arm leaves it. The leave classifier tracks loop labels; an unlabelled `break` in the inner loop would be that loop's.
